desc.p: FHIR ConceptMap mapping the Dutch Edition of SNOMED (http://snomed.info/sct) to the Dutch ICPC1 table (http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icpc-1-nl). Mechanically derived by inverting ConceptMap ICPC1NL_to_SNOMED version 2026-03-31 (http://terminologie.nictiz.nl/ns/ConceptMap/icpc1nl-snomed). Equivalences are inverted: wider becomes narrower and vice versa, equal and relatedto are unchanged. Comments are carried over verbatim from the source map and are phrased from the ICPC to SNOMED perspective. A SNOMED concept may resolve to more than one ICPC code; this map does not encode a rule for choosing between them. Not suitable for automated translation without review.
